Class JdbcOwnerDao

java.lang.Object
dao.jdbc.JdbcOwnerDao
All Implemented Interfaces:
OwnerDao
public class JdbcOwnerDao extends Object implements OwnerDao
JDBC implementation of OwnerDao. Connects to a relational database to perform cat CRUD operations.
Author:
Michal Salabura
